== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-chris-kelly-ls-mind-what-you-have-learned-v/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds CKelly LS MWYHL(v).txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114024354/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-chris-kelly-ls-mind-what-you-have-learned-v.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>6de0d7553197ae3341348bfa0ae0a1ad71365dc215f4db46620b2fc2522dcbde</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 27 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Dash Rendar (V) (ALT)]]: XML <nowiki>210_12^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
* 1x [[Rey (ALT) (Errata 6)]]: XML <nowiki>204_9^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
* 1x [[I Don't Like Sand (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>200_39^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
